# Number.Tan

```m
Number.Tan(number as nullable number) as nullable number
```

Returns the tangent of `number`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Optional |
|---|---|---|
| `number` | `nullable number` | no |

## Examples (engine metadata — not verified here)

Find the tangent of the angle 1.

```m
Number.Tan(1)
```

Stated result:

```m
1.5574077246549023
```
